debug_level.description: Debug level suffix (e.g., ' 2' for more verbose logs); empty to use default level.

vrid.description: Virtual Router ID (0–255) for VRRP interoperability. Only relevant if using VRRP with PIM.

pimsm_enabled.description: Enable PIM-Sparse Mode (required for most production deployments).

pimdm_enabled.description: Enable PIM-Dense Mode (rarely used; disable unless explicitly required).

boundaries.description: List of boundary filters (inbound ACLs) per interface to restrict multicast sources or groups.

acl.description: Access-list name (e.g., 'mcast_boundary'); empty to remove boundary.

rp_address.description: IP address of the Rendezvous Point (RP) for PIM-SM.

bsr_enabled.description: Enable Bootstrap Router (BSR) functionality for dynamic RP discovery.

cp_threshold.description: TTL threshold (0–255) for multicast packets to be forwarded. 0 = forward all.

static_routes.description: List of static (*,G) multicast routes for manual forwarding control.

mode.description: PIM mode for the interface: 'sm' (sparse) or 'dm' (dense).

dr_priority.description: Designated Router (DR) priority (higher = more likely to become DR).

igmp_querier.description: Act as IGMP querier on this interface (for local host group discovery).

access_lists.description: Access-lists to filter multicast groups (e.g., for ACL-based boundaries).

boundary_outgoing.description: Outbound boundaries for multicast (e.g., to limit tunnel ingress).

acl.description: ACL name to apply; empty to remove.
